notes.title: v0.9.6 update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/eb52cf6be85d1d13a9810ed9ce37206daed63f73.png"]
[olist]
Performance & Visual Optimizations:

Adjusted the resolution settings. There are now more resolution options available, and the settings will read your display configuration to offer more suitable resolution choices.

Fixed an issue where resolution settings could fail to apply correctly under certain circumstances.

Game Content Update:

Added new game content, including new levels, enemies, and mechanics.

The new levels can be accessed via the original Boss Rush entrance. These levels feature different enemies, level mechanics, and challenges.
[/olist]

notes.title: New update - Happy lunar new year！
notes.notes:
Hello friends,  The new year is about to bring a small update to *Deviator*. Thank you all for your patience!  Happy lunar new year！
Here’s what’s new:  

1. **SteamDeck Compatibility Update**:  
   - Native resolution support for SteamDeck.  
   - Removed unnecessary icons for devices like mouse from the PC configuration.  
2. **BossRush Update**:  
   - Added new powerful battle skills and charms to the BossRush mode.  
3. **Bug Fixes**:  
   - Fixed an issue where some charms' damage was incorrect.  
   - Optimized some performance aspects.  
   - Fixed a bug where the gacha machine would occasionally freeze.  

**New runes** (from left to right):  
- Dance of Lightning  
- Glass Sword  
- Overload 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/f13e0ab66d0e3a851174ca0445ea0913a085ee56.jpg 

**New Battle Skill**:  
- Slam
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/44e2a76a48d8b177d62a46bd3c2b6b03a22c44e7.jpg

Also, the Portuguese version has been implemented.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/a9296bf7cc139b93d4e699ea301628575bb36fdd.png

Thanks again for your support and enjoy the update!

notes.title: v0.9.5 update
notes.notes:
1. Game Performance Optimization:
   - Package Size Optimization**: The current package size is approximately 5.6 GB.
   - Loading Optimization**: The resource loading speed has been improved.
   
2. Start Screen Blackout Time: The black screen duration on the start screen has been shortened.

3. Control Feel Adjustments: Some consecutive input actions, such as dashing followed by a double jump, have been optimized.

notes.title: v0.9.4 update
notes.notes:
1.Platforming Adjustments: Some platforming sections have been adjusted to balance difficulty.
2.Fixed an issue where items sometimes couldn't be picked up after delivering "Deviator's Remain."
3.Fixed a bug where pressing keys too quickly on the load save screen caused save errors.
4.Fixed an issue where the Prison Boss dying in mid-air prevented the skill drop from being collected.

The following are key issues we are currently aware of and are working on:

1.Performance: Scene loading speed, Steam Deck compatibility issues.
2.Gameplay Experience: Considering adding corresponding runes to improve action recovery time.
3.Mushroom "Swordmaster": Optimizing combat-related actions with the Mushroom Assassin.

notes.title: v0.9.3 update
notes.notes:
1. The operational feel of of attack, two-stage jump, dash and other operations is optimized
2. Fixed a black screen issue in the forest mushroom area
3. Fixed partial text display incomplete issue
4. Fixed a bug where azure crystals can be picked up indefinitely

notes.title: v0.9.2 Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue where the console would be triggered by exceptions.
2. Fixed the bug where depositing money was impossible after obtaining the exchange protocol.
3. Fixed some in-game text description issues.
4. Fixed the shield-raising guidance description and potential stuttering bug in the novice tutorial.
